summary.en: One element copies itself into a file of translucent clones receding into depth, holds, then they all rush back into it and it bounces: one is many.
summary.zh: 一个元素瞬间复印出一列半透明分身，沿斜向纵深排开，停一拍让人数清，再全体加速吸回本体合一并弹一下：一个就是很多个。

fits: Scale from one: many copies, tenants, runs or outputs of the same thing (one prompt, eight shots; one config, every region); the moment a single object is shown to multiply.
notFor: Different items (use a stack or a wall: clones must be the same content); a static display of depth (the copy-and-return is the point); light grounds without an accent glow.

overlaps.note: different cards gathered into a set; clone-echo multiplies one
the optional ×N counter rolls one place per clone; digit-roll is the general odometer

intent.en: Make 'one is many' visible: the viewer counts the copies of one thing, then watches them fold back into it, so scale reads as a property of a single product.
intent.zh: 把“一个就是很多个”变成看得见的事：观众先数清同一个东西有很多份，再看它们收回本体，规模感落在一个产品身上。

content.en: One element (a card, a render, a window) painted once; each clone repeats it with only the outline and one line. Optional ×N counter with a one-line label (≤ 24 chars).
content.zh: 一个元素（卡片、渲染图、窗口），克隆体只留它的轮廓和一行字；可选 ×N 计数器，配一行说明（≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 从一个到很多：同一个东西的多份副本、多租户、多次运行或批量产出（一个提示词出八个镜头、一份配置铺到所有区域）；单个对象被展示为会复制的那一刻。

notFor.zh: 内容各不相同的一组（用堆叠或墙，克隆体必须是同一内容）；静态展示纵深（要的是复制再收回）；没有强调色光晕的浅色底。

pairs.note: a headline count of the copies after the merge

en: Keep the copy-and-return: a file of clones that only sits there reads as a static depth display and loses the point.
The clones must repeat the same content; different items in the file read as a stack, not as scale.
Keep the vanishing point in a corner; in the centre the clones hide behind the element.
On a light ground without the accent glow the faded clones read as smudges.
zh: 必须有“排开再吸回”的动作，只摆一列克隆体就成了静态纵深陈列，意思没了。
克隆体必须是同一内容；放不同内容读作一摞卡片，不读作规模。
灭点放在角上；放在中间克隆体会躲到本体后面。
浅色底又没有强调色光晕时，淡掉的克隆体像污渍。
